moa: recombinant protein inhibitor of plasma kallikrein

approval_evidence.quote: BLA APPROVAL December 1, 2009 ... Kalbitor (ecallantide) injection is indicated for the treatment of acute attacks of hereditary angioedema in patients 16 years of age and older. (FDA approval letter, BLA 125277, Dyax Corporation)

series_start_reason: Takeda prints a Kalbitor line only from fiscal Q4 FY2018 (January-March 2019), the first quarter after it completed the Shire acquisition (Shire's acquisition of Dyax was announced in November 2015; USD, different issuer). The FY2018 column of that table is headed 'Takeda 12 Months @ Actual rate, Shire 3 Months @ Actual rate', so the figure is the 3 months from the January 8, 2019 consolidation to March 31, 2019. Pre-2019 Shire history was not sourced in this batch and is not spliced.
series_end_reason: Takeda's FY2021 Q4 quarterly financial report (January-March 2022; qr2021_q4_qfr_en.pdf) is the last to print a KALBITOR line; its FY2022 forecast table already folds the product into 'Others' with the footnote 'Others in Rare Genetics and Other includes NATPARA/NATPAR, KALBITOR', and Takeda's FY2022 Q1 quarterly financial report (qr2022_q1_qfr_en.pdf) and every later report contain no KALBITOR line (zero text lines mention Kalbitor in the FY2022 Q1 and FY2026 Q1 reports as read with pdfplumber; pdftotext finds the name in no quarterly financial report after FY2021 Q4).
notes: Scope is Takeda's worldwide Kalbitor line: the total column of the 'Product Sales Analysis' table (Bn JPY, 'Sales amount includes royalty income and service income'); in the regional columns the line is entirely U.S. (US column equals the total in the FY2019-FY2021 tables). The regional split of 2019Q1 is not printed. Row amounts are small (about 1 billion JPY per quarter), so the one-decimal printing gives coarse values. No launch quarter is cited. Label printed: 'Kalbitor' (FY2018-FY2019), 'KALBITOR' (FY2020-FY2021).
search_log: fetched the takeda.com quarterly-results pages for 2014-2025 and the current page, plus the legacy Shire financial-results page, and collected every PDF/XLSX link (work/takeda_links.json); downloaded the PDFs from FY2014 onward and the Shire press releases/presentations from FY2013 onward (work/pdf), scanned them with pdftotext for the brand names, then re-read each cited page with pdfplumber (the verifier's extractor) so quoted figures match its text layer
Bigdata.com was not used: the issuer's own IR documents were located directly from the takeda.com pages

ladder rung a/b: Takeda prints the brand on its own line in the product sales analysis of every quarterly document from the FY2018 Q4 summary of financial statements onward (FY2018 Q4 summary; FY2019 data books; FY2020-FY2026 quarterly financial reports); no fuller supplement or other issuer was needed

each quarter was read from the quarter's own document (the FY2018 Q4 summary of financial statements, the FY2019 Q1-Q4 data books, the FY2020 Q1 - FY2026 Q1 quarterly financial reports) as current, not from a later comparative column, unless stated in that row's context

cross-check: for each fiscal year FY2019-FY2025 the four quarterly values were summed and compared with the full-year product figure printed in the Q4 document (differences at most 0.1 billion JPY, rounding)

FY2025 Q4 has two versions on takeda.com (original of 2026-05-13, marked as superseded, and the version amended on 2026-06-05 for a subsequent event); the cited document is the amended version, the product-line figures are identical in both

Shire (the prior owner) printed this brand in USD in its own quarterly press releases (legacy Shire documents on the takeda.com Shire page, FY2013-FY2018); those documents were located but not extracted or spliced, because the issuer, currency and revenue definition differ from Takeda's JPY line
EDGAR was not searched: the Takeda quarterly documents on takeda.com were sufficient for every quarter

end of series: pdfplumber text of qr2022_q1_qfr_en.pdf and qr2026_q1_qfr_en.pdf has zero lines mentioning Kalbitor; pdftotext of all downloaded FY2022-FY2026 quarterly financial reports finds no KALBITOR; the FY2021 Q4 report's FY2022 forecast table footnote *7 names KALBITOR inside 'Others'; the Takeda 20-F of June 2022 (20-f_2022_06_29_eg.pdf) mentions KALBITOR once, in a patent/commercialisation table (not a sales figure)
